claims.text: The hotel is in Dubai Marina, within minutes of Dubai Internet City, Media City, golf clubs and malls.

findings.quote: Nestled in the renowned Dubai Marina, our Dubai family hotel is near the city center and within minutes of Dubai Internet City, Media City, golf clubs, malls, and more.

claims.text: The hotel is steps away from The Walk at JBR, with restaurants and bars overlooking Dubai Marina.

findings.quote: Located steps away from The Walk at JBR, Grosvenor House, a Luxury Collection Hotel features a variety of elegant restaurants and bars overlooking Dubai Marina.

claims.text: The hotel's twin towers are an instantly recognizable landmark in Dubai Marina.

findings.quote: The hotel’s glittering twin towers are an instantly recognizable landmark in the Dubai Marina.

claims.text: The hotel complex is set apart by its blue lights and unique architectural designs.

findings.quote: Set apart by its blue lights and unique architectural designs, the hotel complex continues to distinguish itself

claims.text: Rooms combine marble floors, natural hues, modern decor and large windows overlooking turquoise waters.

findings.quote: Fusing marble floors, natural hues, modern décor, and large windows overlooking turquoise waters

claims.text: Select rooms have a private balcony.

findings.quote: Select rooms further elevate your stay with a private balcony, offering a secluded vantage point for these stunning vistas.

claims.text: Rooms and suites come with on-call butler service.

findings.quote: The hotel features 750 spacious, contemporary guest rooms and suites with signature Luxury Collection beds, large windows with spectacular views of the Marina, complimentary WiFi and attentive on-call 5-star butler service.

claims.text: One-bedroom suites have Dubai Marina views, a living room and a fully equipped kitchen.

findings.quote: Our one-bedroom suites reflect the signature grandeur of Grosvenor House featuring Dubai Marina Views, living Room and fully equipped kitchen.

claims.text: There is a fully equipped gym in each tower.

findings.quote: with a fully equipped gym in each tower

claims.text: Sanara Spa blends holistic therapies with modern practices.

findings.quote: It blends holistic therapies with modern practices, offering personalized experiences that promote relaxation, balance, and overall wellbeing.

claims.text: The Level 5 club lounge has a dedicated family lounge for younger guests.

findings.quote: Level 5 boasts three lounge areas, plus a separate bar lounge, family lounge, and a meeting room.
A dedicated family lounge caters exclusively to younger guests, allowing families to relax in a comfortable, family-friendly environment.

claims.text: The Luxury Collection Concierge is available 24 hours a day and is a member of Les Clefs d'Or.

findings.quote: Available 24 hours a day, our Luxury Collection Concierge is a bilingual, certified destination expert proudly wearing the "Les Clefs d’Or," the gilt insignia of the celebrated international concierge society

claims.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of Dubai Marina, the Arabian Sea or Palm Jumeirah.

findings.quote: The visual splendor continues through floor-to-ceiling windows, which frame breathtaking panoramas of the glittering Dubai Marina, the azure Arabian Sea, or the legendary Palm Jumeirah.

claims.text: Guests have access to the private beach at Le Royal Meridien Beach Resort & Spa.

findings.quote: plus access to the private beach at Le Royal Méridien Beach Resort & Spa.

claims.text: Sanara Spa is a wellness sanctuary inspired by ancient healing and the seven chakras.

findings.quote: Sanara Spa is a tranquil wellness sanctuary inspired by ancient healing and the seven chakras.

claims.text: The Royal Suites are on the 9th and 10th floors and include a lounge area, kitchenette, dining area and master suite.

findings.quote: These impressive suites are located on the 9th and 10th floors and include a lounge area, kitchenette, dining area and a stunning master suite.

claims.text: City Social by Jason Atherton is on the 43rd floor and serves European cuisine with a focus on wood-fired dishes, with a bar overlooking Palm Jumeirah.

findings.quote: Located on the 43rd floor, City Social by Jason Atherton serves European cuisine with a focus on wood-fired dishes, complemented by a beautiful bar overlooking Palm Jumeirah.

claims.text: The beach is at Le Royal Meridien Beach Resort & Spa, where guests have access to its private beach, rather than at the hotel itself.

findings.quote: access to the private beach at Le Royal Méridien Beach Resort & Spa for an inimitable 5-star hotel experience.
